problems: The title and caption are about a compass bowl, but no bowl, water or needle is visible in any frame: the storyboard and all three full-size frames show only a dark boulder, a blue hydrangea bush, a pink flower and grass.
Nothing in the film happens to anything: no object reacts, so there is no experiment to watch, not even one that failed.
Storyboard frames 10-11: the bird's feet step into and through the hydrangea bush, which neither bends nor moves (clipping).

Storyboard frames 7-13 and the 50% frame: the walker's body is cut off at the top edge, so all you get is a pair of legs and part of a yellow belly crossing the frame. At the 75% frame only a few yellow feathers stick in from the left corner.
Storyboard frames 1-6 and 13-16 (more than half the 8 s) are the same still shot of the bush and the flower with nothing moving.
The whole foreground is in deep shadow, and the dull, dark green takes up the lower half of every frame.
posts.critique: The bowl the post is named after never appears, so the caption's own admission is the only thing it really shows: a bird's legs crossing an empty, dark shot and clipping through a bush. It reads as broken footage, not a failed experiment, and I would not show it to anyone.
